purpose: Independent leading-order four-cut Keldysh sum versus normalized Fock-state enumeration, plus explicit sech-squared pulse Fourier-transform check
model: 1+1D normal-ordered real scalar lambda(t) phi^4, free Gaussian vacuum, homogeneous pulse
executed_source_revision: source content pinned by SHA-256 and Git blob SHA; executed from a cleanly written source file in the ChatGPT Linux container before archival commit

validation.checks: The script asserts nonnegative spectra, agreement of independent cut and Fock sums at every cutoff/channel, and agreement of numerical Simpson transform with the analytic sech^2 transform.

limitations: No nonperturbative time evolution or full Gaussian subtraction at higher orders.
Finite volume and momentum-sum truncation only; no infinite-volume or continuum extrapolation.
No higher-order rescattering, loop corrections, or comparison with an exact Hamiltonian solver.
